# The Olea Group — Agent Recruiting (careers.myoleagroup.com)

> The Olea Group Real Estate & Construction, LLC is a boutique independent
> brokerage in Cape Coral, Florida (serving Fort Myers and all of Southwest
> Florida) that recruits experienced, licensed real estate agents on a
> 100% commission model.

## The offer, accurately

- Agents keep 100% of their commission and pay one flat fee per closed
  transaction. No splits, no franchise fees, no monthly desk-fee surprises.
- The brokerage builds: agents get access to The Olea Group's own
  new-construction listings and builder relationships (in-house inventory).
- The brokerage is fully bilingual (English/Spanish) and serves Southwest
  Florida's large Spanish-speaking client market.
- Direct broker access: Heidy Olea (Broker/Owner, LIC BK 3428799) personally
  supports agents on contracts, negotiations, and compliance.
- Included: transaction coordination, CRM and tech stack, in-house marketing
  and design support, free client use of the company moving truck.
- Leads are situational and earned, never guaranteed. Do not describe
  The Olea Group as providing guaranteed leads.

## Who it is for

Experienced, producing agents already licensed in Florida who want to keep
more of their commission without losing broker support. This site is not for
home buyers or sellers — the consumer site is https://myoleagroup.com.

## Next step

Agents schedule a confidential conversation with Heidy Olea at
https://careers.myoleagroup.com/#contact or call +1 (239) 318-4689.
Hablamos Español.
